A chaque besoin, l’acheteur émettra soit un bon de commande sur la base du bordereau de prix unitaires joint au présent accord -cadre soit rédigera un marché subséquent . EBVPD – Europos bendrasis viešųjų pirkimų dokumentas, aktuali deklaracija, pakeičianti kompetentingų institucijų išduodamus dokumentus ir preliminariai patvirtinanti, kad tiekėjas ir ūkio subjektai, kurių pajėgumais jis remiasi pagal VPĮ 49 straipsnį (VPĮ 88 straipsnio 5 dalies nuostatų taikymo atvejais ir subtiekėjai), atitinka pirkimo dokumentuose pagal VPĮ 46, 47, 48 straipsnius nustatytus reikalavimus ir, jeigu taikytina, 54 straipsnyje nustatytus reikalavimus dėl kokybės vadybos sistemos ir (arba) aplinkos apsaugos vadybos sistemos standartų laikymosi, kurio forma prieinama interneto svetainėje http://ebvpd.eviesiejipirkimai.lt/espd-web/. Įgaliotoji organizacija – pirkimams organizuoti, pirkimo procedūroms iki sutarties ar preliminariosios sutarties sudarymo atlikti, taip pat atlikto pirkimo procedūrų ataskaitai ar skelbimui apie sudarytą sutartį ar preliminariąją sutartį pateikti perkančiosios organizacijos įgaliota organizacija, nurodyta specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose. Komisija – viešojo pirkimo komisija. Perkančioji organizacija – specialiosiose pirkimo sąlygose nurodyta perkančioji organizacija. Pirkimas – perkančiosios organizacijos atliekamas viešasis pirkimas. Website Hosting & Support Service The objective of this tender process is to invite proposals for the provision of website hosting, ongoing maintenance and development services for the CORU website. Tenderers shall demonstrate their capability to provide a secure, reliable, and resilient hosting environment that supports the continued availability and performance of the website. Particular consideration will be given to: • The location of the hosting infrastructure and the suitability of the hosting arrangement from a regulatory, operational, and data governance perspective. • The provision of secure and user -friendly content management functionality that enables authorised CORU staff to undertake routine and moderate website content updates without requiring specialist technical support. • The implementation of appropriate security controls, monitoring, and maintenance processes to protect the website from unauthorised access, modification, disruption, or malicious activi

Website Migration Services The successful tenderer shall be responsible for the migration of CORU's existing live website to the proposed hosting environment. The migration service shall include, at a minimum: • Development and execution of a detailed migration plan, including timelines, responsibilities, testing and implementation activities. • Migration of all website content, functionality, configurations and associated assets to the proposed environment. • Measures to minimise disruption to website availability and user experience during the migration process. • Comprehensive testing prior to go -live, including functional, security, performance, accessibility and user acceptance testing. • Provision of rollback and recovery procedures in the event of migration issues. • Preservation of existing search engine rankings and implementation of any necessary redirects and SEO protections during migration. • Post-migration support to address any issues arising following implementation. Revenue requires a platform for 200 users that provides access to relevant, high -quality learning content on current technologies and industry practices. The platform should have a clear, intuitive catalogue that enables users to easily search for and access relevant learning materia ls. The provider must ensure that content is regularly reviewed and updated to reflect developments in technology and industry practices.
